{{Quote|Put all your covert ops resources toward finding Ton Phanan and Wraith Squadron. And kill every last one of them''"<br />"''Yes, sir.|General Stavin Thaal to Rossin|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Rossin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pop-Dogs|Pop-Dog]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who was loyal to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and was present to view the destruction of the [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]] following [[Wraith Squadron]]'s escape from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. After the destruction of the Station, General Thaal ordered Rossin to retrieve the telemetry of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from which the Wraiths escaped on and their [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] escorts, which Rossin complied.<ref name="MK" />
